title: fix(list): "Add group field" asks which field, and offers only fields that can group (#36204)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuTGE2nV5qgwDdDHZ12i82BA)_

Fixes #36204

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@object-ui/components`'s `GroupingEditor` gains the optional props `askFieldOnAdd`, `fieldOptionsLoading` and `fieldLabel`, and its `labels` the optional `noFields`; `@object-ui/i18n` gains `list.noGroupableFields` in every locale (zh-Hant regenerated); nothing removed or renamed. `@object-ui/plugin-list`'s package exports are unchanged.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表里点「添加分组字段」：不带默认值，也不马上分组。字段下拉直接展开，选了才分组；不选关掉，列表不分组，也不出现「放弃」「保存」。
- 下拉只列单选（状态也是单选）、勾选、人员、关联记录，每种只含单值的。文本、数字、日期、多选都不列。先列这个视图的列（按列的顺序），再列对象里其它这类字段，负责人也在里面。HotCRM「全部客户」下拉是 行业、类型、健康度…母公司、是否活跃…客户负责人，没有 客户名称、年营收、日期。
- 对象里一个这类字段都没有：按钮灰掉，下面写「没有可以用来分组的字段」。字段类型还没读回来的一瞬间按钮也是灰的，但不显示这句话，不会误报。
- 已经按别的字段（比如名称）分组的视图照常显示，这一级仍能换、能删。分组仍是草稿（#35955），不写视图。

## What changes

The card was rewritten after this PR's first version (rewrite note 7072750584, claim amend 7073321855): the first version's "default to the first single select" and "suitable types first, others still selectable" are both gone. In both Group editors (the wide toolbar's Group panel and the 视图设置 menu's Group level):

1. **No default, no grouping on the click.** "Add group field" opens a row whose field dropdown is already open. The level is written only on a pick; closing the dropdown without one writes nothing.
2. **Only fields that can group** (`isGroupableField`): `select`, `radio`, `boolean`, `toggle`, `user`, `lookup`, `master_detail`, `tree`, and not `multiple: true`. Order: the view's columns in the reader's column order (`schema.columnState.order`), then the object's other fields of those types the reader may read and the definition does not hide, business fields before system ones (the Filter panel's tiers).
3. **None to offer:** the button is drawn disabled with `aria-describedby` on the reason 「没有可以用来分组的字段」 / "No field here can group the list".
4. **Still a draft** (#35955): the pick goes through `onGroupingChange` to the host's `listDraft.patch` and the URL, as before.

Not changed, per the card: the group display, kanban, date grouping. A view already grouped by another kind of field keeps its level, shown under the field's label (`fieldLabel`), and the level can still be changed or removed.

Code:

- `@object-ui/components` `GroupingEditor`: `askFieldOnAdd` (the pending row, testid `grouping-field-pending`), `fieldOptionsLoading`, `labels.noFields` (disabled button + `grouping-no-fields`), `fieldLabel`. Without them the editor behaves as before.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list` `ListView`: one `groupOptions` list and one `groupFieldLabel` for both editors; `ViewSettingsPopover` takes `groupOptions` / `groupOptionsLoading` from it (`groupFieldOptions` and `isGroupableField` are module helpers, not package exports). `allFields` carries `type` and `multiple` from the definition.
- Platform checklist `records-forms.grid-personalization` rev 11 (after #36133's rev 10): steps[3] says the dropdown opens without grouping, lists only groupable fields, and Status is picked there.

### Small calls made in this thread (Sales 22:19:27Z rule)

- **A field whose type is not loaded yet** (L2 should-fix): while the definition read is in flight, nothing is offered and the button is disabled *without* the reason, so it never says "nothing to group by" before the types are known. If there is no definition to read at all (a host with no `getObjectSchema`, or the read failed), no type is known and every column is offered, as before. Both pinned.
- **"Status"**: the spec has no `status` type; a status is a `select`. `radio` counts as a single select.
- **"Linked record"** includes `master_detail` and `tree` beside `lookup`; **"tick"** includes `toggle` beside `boolean`.
- **Fields outside the columns**: the card says 「这个对象没有…」, so the object's other groupable fields are offered after the columns. The record owner is one (the maintainer's 「加上负责人」). Created by / updated by are offered only when the view shows them as a column; otherwise every object would have a person field and the disabled state could never appear.
- **A field the reader may not read** is never offered; a level already holding one keeps showing its name, not its label (#11984).
- **Second level**: the same list, less the fields levels use.

## Verification

- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/grouping-editor-add-default-36204.test.tsx` (11): the click writes nothing and opens the dropdown; a pick writes the level; second level; Escape writes nothing; `noFields` disabled + described; loading disabled without a reason; enabled when options arrive; `fieldLabel`; three CONTROLs without the new props.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.groupAddDefault-36204.test.tsx` (16), both editors: the click writes nothing, the dropdown is Industry, Owner, Stage, VIP, Parent account, Record owner (no name, text, date, number, multi-select, hidden field, unshown created-by), a pick writes the level with no `create`/`update`/`delete`; Escape; no groupable field → disabled + reason; second level; column order; created-by as a column is offered; a view grouped by name shows "Customer name" and can change; loading → disabled without reason, enabled once the definition answers; CONTROL with no definition offers every column; View settings labels a non-column pick (Record owner) on its level and on the menu's Group row; the helper functions.
- Direction, measured: with `main`'s `grouping-editor.tsx`, `ListView.tsx` and `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` swapped in, 22 of these 26 fail; the other four include the three editor CONTROLs. The View settings label pin added at `89c82900` fails with that commit's one-line host change reverted.
- Updated where tests read the old first-column default: `ListView.harness` (#32631: fields typed, CONTROL re-reads the level options after the pick), `ListView.onGroupingChange-11860` (stub answers `getObjectSchema`; the add picks from the dropdown), `ListView.fieldListRead-11984` (the Group list offers `Status`/`Secret Status` only; the full-read control probes Group with the select), `ObjectView.listUrlState-11860` (no definition there, so every column, `priority` picked).
- `vitest run` packages/plugin-list, components `grouping*` + `list-builders*`, app-shell `ObjectView.listUrlState-11860`, packages/i18n: 293 files, 4039 passed / 13 skipped.
- `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`: components, plugin-list, app-shell, i18n, exit 0. ESLint on changed files: 0 errors. `check-platform-checklist.mjs`: OK. Changeset checks: OK.

## Evidence (1440×900 @2x, zh-CN, light and dark; `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/36204/`, index in its `README.md`)

Console from this branch's `ui/`; every non-GET request recorded in the page.

- Self-built 「客户」 (package `com.demo.kehu`), 「全部客户」 (客户名称, 所属行业, 负责人, 电话): `v2-1440-{light,dark}-kehu-all-1-after-add-dropdown.png` — the click opens the dropdown (所属行业, 负责人), list not grouped, no request. `-2-list-grouped.png` — after picking 所属行业: 4 groups of 3, 「放弃」「保存」; the only request is the grouped read `POST /api/v1/data/kehu_customer/query`.
- 「联系方式」 (客户名称, 负责人, 电话, 签约日期): `v2-…-kehu-contact-1-after-add-dropdown.png` (负责人, then the non-column 所属行业), `-2-closed-no-pick.png` (Escape: no level, no 「放弃」「保存」, no request).
- 拜访记录 (text, textarea, number, date, multi-select + platform owner): `v2-…-kehu-visit-*` — dropdown 负责人 only.
- 便签 (`ownership: 'org'`, no owner; only text, textarea, number, date, multi-select): `v2-…-kehu-note-nofield-0-group-panel.png` — disabled, 「没有可以用来分组的字段」, a click does nothing.
- HotCRM (`main` 6090c83) 客户 → 全部客户: `v2-…-hotcrm-accounts-1-after-add-dropdown.png` — 行业, 类型, 健康度, 商务能力, 付款周期, 销售区域, 母公司, 是否活跃, 审批状态, 来源线索, 客户分层, 客户细分, 客户负责人; no write, not grouped. `-2-list-grouped.png` — grouped by 行业, 「放弃」「保存」; only the grouped read.
- `before-*` shots show `main` (one click groups by 客户名称, 12 groups of one). `v1/` holds this PR's superseded first version.

## Since the first reads (L1-b ACCEPT 7073310792, L2 FAIL 7073316679)

The rework answers the L2's four must-fixes (default, filter, disabled state, rewrite note) and its should-fixes (untyped-field rule + test, checklist, changeset, body). Nits: the plugin-list members are out of Clause-② (not package-public); the harness CONTROL re-checks the level options after the pick. Heads: `4e90470e` (rework), `953c8cbf` (record owner offered, provenance only as a column; L1-b delta ACCEPT 7074055354, declaration L2 delta PASS 7074084200), `89c82900` (L2 S1: `ListView` hands `groupFieldLabel` to `ViewSettingsPopover`, which labels the menu's Group row and the level with it, so a non-column pick no longer reads as `owner_id`/`industry`; pinned; browser: 「联系方式」 pick 所属行业, the row reads 「分组 所属行业」, `v2-1440-{light,dark}-kehu-contact-3-menu-row-noncolumn.png`. L2 N4: the changeset headline is `fix(list)` like the title).

## Overlap

`main` merged after #36133 (`0d8fc77b`): the one conflict was `records-forms.grid-personalization`, resolved by keeping #36133's steps[2] and rev 10 row; this PR's row is rev 11.
